founderExactAnswer.question: How many opportunities can the hotel no longer commercially pursue because the one-time event has already concluded?
founderExactAnswer.clarification: This count is EXPIRED_ONE_TIME_EVENT only — not 'stored date before reference'. Duplicates of expired events are counted separately under DUPLICATE_EVENT_RECORD. Recurring brands among the expired set may still warrant future-cycle account development, but the dated 2026 (or earlier) event thesis is not pursuable as a live sales opportunity.
